title: The Step Inside The Run — where a panel-owned card belongs
question: A write_todos card is panel-owned, so it renders as a sibling beneath the run that counts it. Does it belong inside the run frame, and if so as what?

views.description: The measured shipping state: header says 3 steps, rail shows 2, WRITE_TODOS below the frame, Square glyph reading as an unticked box
The card becomes step 3 on RunCard's rail. One grammar, count true by construction. Requires the RunCard extraction.
Inside the frame but in its own panel-owned band. Keeps panel=now / chat=happened. Two grammars in one card.
RunCard untouched; a continuation bracket groups run and siblings. No G-5 obligation; count still disagrees.
